method: Manual refresh of live GitHub PR heads, check jobs, and filtered failure logs; lane ownership preserved; followed by closeout, after-task structure, prose lint, JSON, and diff checks.
coverage: Whole report by continuity from v24; refreshed exact-head states for Julia #1245/#1240/#1237 and R #1663/#1657/#1659, including current failures and owner boundaries.
score_reason: The report uses exact files, SHAs, run IDs, and explicit limits. Some technical sentences are dense, but the PR status is separated into short bullets.
confidence_reason: Live GitHub metadata and patches plus local worktree inventories and lane preflight were reviewed. The #1233 behavior is described from its test assertions and is not represented as a resolved model comparison.

science_gate_reason: This report records a documentation reconciliation, not a new scientific result.

calibration_status: No style controls were used; this is an uncalibrated editorial judgment.
